claim: On December 28, 2022 ElastiCache for Redis OSS gained support for modifying in-transit encryption settings: you can change the TLS configuration of Redis OSS clusters without re-building or re-provisioning the clusters or impacting application availability.
question: When could in-transit encryption first be changed on an existing ElastiCache for Redis OSS cluster?

values.display: without the need to re-build or re-provision the clusters
values.spoken: without rebuilding or re-provisioning the clusters

note: Current truth: modifying the in-transit encryption setting of an existing cluster needs Valkey 7.2 and later or Redis OSS 7 and later (fact elasticache-in-transit-modify-existing-versions). Older material may say it can only be set at creation.
